title: TCS on Foreign Remittance under Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) & Overseas Tour Packages
plainTextSummary: Authorised dealers collect tax at source on foreign remittances under LRS exceeding INR 7 Lakhs (0.5% for education loan, 5% for medical/education, 20% for other remittances) and on overseas tour program packages (5% up to INR 7 Lakhs and 20% on excess).
